summary: One new test added (findById_legacyDocumentWithoutOwnerChatId_readsAsNull). It correctly exercises the real BSON round-trip via embedded Mongo (save -> findById), uses StepVerifier idiomatically (assertNext + verifyComplete implicitly rejects any deserialization error), and the assertion is specific (getOwnerChatId() == null). Naming matches the file's methodName_scenario_outcome convention. Reuses newBot(...) without modifying its signature. BotTokenLeakTest invariant preserved: Bot.java declares no toString. The test passes the litmus test — removing 'private Long ownerChatId;' breaks compilation, and switching to primitive long flips the assertion (would deserialize to 0L), so the test actively pins both the field's existence AND the wrapper-Long contract called out in Decision 14 / Risk R6. One minor: a positive-path round-trip case (setOwnerChatId(N) -> save -> reload -> assert == N) is not strictly required for this task (the riskier semantic is 'absent field reads as null', and a positive round-trip would mostly test framework behavior), but it would cheaply tighten the contract documentation for the next task that actually populates the field.

findings.finding: No positive-path round-trip test for ownerChatId — only the null/absent case is covered. The task scope deliberately limits to the legacy-document contract (Risk R6, TDD Anchor), and a getter/setter round-trip largely re-tests Spring Data MongoDB's wrapper-Long handling rather than business logic, so this is defensible. However, Wave-2/Wave-3 tasks will populate this field via webhook ingestion; an explicit save-with-value/reload-equals-value assertion would document the write side of the contract one task earlier and protect against a future accidental change of the field to a non-stored property (e.g., a hand-rolled @Transient or a custom converter).
findings.suggestion: Optional follow-up (not blocking this task): add one more @Test in BotRepositoryTest — e.g. findById_persistedOwnerChatId_roundTripsValue: build a Bot via newBot(...), call bot.setOwnerChatId(987654321L), then StepVerifier.create(botRepository.save(bot).flatMap(saved -> botRepository.findById(saved.getId()))).assertNext(reloaded -> assertThat(reloaded.getOwnerChatId()).isEqualTo(987654321L)).verifyComplete(). Cheap, pairs naturally with the null-case test, and pins the round-trip contract before Epic 04b consumers arrive. Defer to the Wave-2 author if preferred.
